note: Every GITHUB_TOKEN write grant in .github/workflows/*.yml, keyed by workflow basename, job (null = workflow-level) and scope. ops/tests/test_github_workflows.sh fails on any write or write-all not listed here, on an entry without a reason, and on an entry that no longer matches a grant.
